dimensions.name: Silent planning-model swap when SWE_DEFAULT_RUNTIME is set without model env vars
dimensions.review_prompt: In swe_af/execution/schemas.py:756-809, _default_planning_model gains a runtime parameter and changes behavior: when SWE_DEFAULT_RUNTIME=open_code or codex is set with no model env var (SWE_DEFAULT_MODEL/AI_MODEL/HARNESS_MODEL), planning reasoners (pm, architect, tech_lead, sprint_planner) now receive the runtime's base default instead of the historical sonnet fallback. Verify that the new callers of _default_planning_model(runtime=...) pass the correct normalized runtime, and confirm that any deployment relying on SWE_DEFAULT_RUNTIME for CLI selection but implicitly expecting sonnet for planning is documented as a breaking change in release notes or migration guide.

dimensions.name: HARNESS_MODEL scoping to open_code only silently redirects claude_code/codex deployments
dimensions.review_prompt: In swe_af/execution/schemas.py:709-737, _default_model_from_env now skips HARNESS_MODEL when runtime != 'open_code'. Any Docker deployment with the baked HARNESS_MODEL=openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731 (Dockerfile, go/Dockerfile) that runs claude_code or codex without SWE_DEFAULT_MODEL/AI_MODEL set will now silently get the runtime's native default instead of the openrouter model id that previously leaked in. Verify that the Docker bakes match _OPENROUTER_AUTO_DEFAULT_MODEL, and that claude_code/codex paths never call _default_model_from_env without a runtime argument that would still consult HARNESS_MODEL.

rationale: The change introduces two significant behavioral shifts: (1) the planning model fallback changes from a global 'sonnet' to a runtime-specific default when SWE_DEFAULT_RUNTIME is set, which is a silent change for existing deployments, and (2) the HARNESS_MODEL variable is now scoped to 'open_code' only, fixing a cross-runtime leak but changing behavior for any deployment that relied on that leak for model steering.
